title: RAIL in the Wild: Operationalizing Responsible AI Evaluation Using Anthropic’s Value Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the occurrence frequency of AI-expressed values related to fairness, equitable representation, and bias mitigation mapped from a large dataset of anonymized real-world conversations to the RAIL framework.
Measuring the proportion of conversations in which the model expresses values such as 'cultural respect' and 'inclusiveness', mapping these responses to the 'Inclusivity' dimension.
